experiments.timing_scope: Batched object lookup plus full returned-byte FNV consumption; copy also copies every byte. Caller workspace allocation and verification excluded; zlib internal allocation/deallocation remains timed. Construction includes final compaction.
experiments.storage_scope: Dynamic vector buffer capacities only, plus caller lookup scratch where labeled. Container/control objects, allocator headers and transient internal zlib allocations are excluded; these counters are not process RSS.
experiments.view_contract: Borrowed view valid until next lookup on that workspace; zlib decodes each compressed-block access with no persistent decoded cache.
experiments.construction_estimate_note: Estimated capacity accounting, not RSS or an upper bound; includes input strings and approximate hash-table nodes, omits allocator headers and zlib internals.
